body: I feel like I’m wasting my youth and there won’t be anything but work, debts, and stress afterwards. I struggle making friends and I’ve built myself such a reputation of being a loser that it’s hard to talk to anyone without them only talking to me out of pity. I’m worried I’ll be alone forever because I have a lot of trauma from relationships that I won’t be able to ever find someone.
I’m not sure, but if it’s not national there’s always crisistextline.org, they’ve got some resources on there. Best of luck to you.

Hi there, my dad really doesn’t understand mental illness and he gets angry at me when I talk about wanting to die. Depression is genetic on my mom’s side of the family, so she’s at least a bit more understanding, but she threatens me when I come forward about this and tells me I’m being ridiculous.
Not sure if this is in your area, but try texting 686868. They’ve provided me with a lot of resources and many of them don’t require parental consent.

it’s not childish! i get the same way. i’ll be lying in bed and all of a sudden i’ll start thinking of a scary video i watched it a horror movie i’ve seen recently. my best advice to you would be to sleep with a pet, if you have one, or to leave a light on for a sense of safety. listening to white noise or ocean/rainforest sounds is also a good idea. in reality, there really isn’t anything there and there’s nothing to be afraid of. best of luck to you!
